overall_strategy_summary: BNP Paribas is the Eurozone's largest bank, operating across retail (France, Belgium, Italy), CIB, investment solutions, and insurance. Key digital: AssetFoundry tokenization platform, tokenized MMF on Ethereum (public, Feb 2026), Canton Network member, Digital Asset $135M investment, Eurosystem CBDC experiments. AXA IM (now part of BNP Paribas Group) brings investment innovation. Broader strategy: European market leadership, MiCA positioning, sustainable finance, insurance growth, integrated group model across AM/Securities Services/CIB.

people.team_structure: Cross-group model: Asset Management (issuer), Securities Services (transfer agent, wallet, keys), CIB (AssetFoundry platform). Canton Network membership. AXA IM now part of group.
people.leadership_commitment: Active. Multiple senior leaders involved. Systematic experimentation across private and public blockchains. Canton Network investment.
people.workforce_signals: ~190,000 employees. Eurozone's largest bank by assets. AXA IM acquisition adds investment innovation capability.

analyst_judgment.strategy_posture: Systematic experimenter. Building full-stack capabilities across group. European-focused.
analyst_judgment.likely_objectives: Build European tokenization leadership position. Leverage integrated model (AM + Securities Services + CIB). Prepare for MiCA-enabled market.
analyst_judgment.not_prioritizing: Crypto trading, retail digital asset access, stablecoin issuance, US market.
analyst_judgment.strongest_areas: Full-stack group model, AssetFoundry platform, Canton Network positioning, European regulatory alignment, systematic experimentation.
analyst_judgment.weakest_areas: Still experimental (intra-group only). No client-facing production products. Behind HSBC and JPMorgan in scale.
analyst_judgment.build_vs_buy_hypothesis: Build. AssetFoundry proprietary. Digital Asset/Canton for ecosystem.

evidence.claim: BNP Paribas issued tokenized MMF share class on public Ethereum in February 2026
BNP Paribas and HSBC joined Canton Network

process.front_office: Tokenized MMF share classes for institutional investors.
process.middle_office: Securities Services as transfer agent with wallet and key management. Permissioned access models on public chains.
process.back_office: AssetFoundry platform: tokenization, network connectivity, wallet functionalities. Ethereum (public, permissioned overlay). Private blockchain (Luxembourg). Securities Services for fund dealing.
process.operating_model_maturity: Pilot/experimental. Two MMF tokenizations completed. Intra-group experiments.
